answers.ask: What style should the venue read as - a modern arena concert, a festival main stage, a nightclub?
answers.answer: Le lieu doit être une scène principale de festival moderne, avec une esthétique spectaculaire et dynamique.

answers.ask: Is there an audience area with a defined capacity, or is the stage the whole build?
answers.answer: Ajoutez une zone de public simple devant l’estrade, sans capacité définie ; la scène reste l’élément central du build.

answers.ask: Who operates the interactive control system - is it a physical console in the world, or a screen menu?
answers.answer: Le système se contrôle via une console physique interactive placée sur le côté de la scène.

scene_prompt: Create a large 3D modern festival main stage with a spectacular, dynamic presentation. Center the immense raised stage as the dominant structure, framed by giant screens, a dynamic lighting rig, and smoke-effect fixtures. Place a simple open audience area directly in front of the stage. Position a physical interactive control console at one side of the stage.
agent_notes: A huge stage with a lighting rig, giant screens and smoke, confirmed as a modern festival main stage with an audience area in front, is Entertainment's Performance Venue on venue-stage — the one shape where the crowd faces a single direction and every sightline converges on the stage, which landmark-focal would lose. social-hub is that audience floor, kept as an open standing area because the author asked for a simple one with no defined capacity, and spawn-first-reveal puts arrivals facing the stage. I dropped the preset's spectator-bleachers for the same reason: raked seating would add tiered elevation the answer explicitly declined. Deciding without a user, I treated the lighting rig, screens, smoke and music as stage dressing carried in the build rather than options, and placed the interactive control console at the side of the stage as the answer specified — no option covers a player-operated console, so it needs to survive as a stated request. Everyone walks here, so this is an ordinary walkable P0 build, not a SET.

notes: placement mirrored from option 'spawn-first-reveal': no siting rule given
